name: Roman Wade
life: “I still remember getting a broom on my first morning after release.” People around Maré Coffee know Roman by a small Sunday habit. Roman likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I got my first contract sweeping that floor after a conviction. Offices need cleaners too, and I want the hiring terms in writing.
appearance: Roman has fine brows over wide-set eyes. Look for a dark undercut with a longer wave on top. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a black overshirt with pearl buttons with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. In conversation Roman takes off the watch before a long conversation.
personality: Roman is kind in very practical ways and prickly about being thanked in public. Roman loves being recognized by the people who notice what happens after the guests have left.
agenda: To get fair hiring terms recorded.
family: Priya Solis is Roman’s half-sibling. Roman can stop the walk at any corner. Priya chooses the familiar route. Walking side by side makes it easier to disagree without turning each disagreement into a contest. Asked about *A shelf of apologies*, Priya says, “I took mine on a ship and carried it through three oceans.”
connections: Damian Fadel. The worker hired after prison shows the keyholder which overlooked jobs should be visible on the tour.

reactions.situation: A worker says their job was left out of the consultation
reactions.response: Roman records the missing job in the worker's own words for the consultation.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Roman writes down the shift time accurately, then helps them explain the circumstances without having to tell the whole room.
